question: How much did we pay out on claims each month in Q2 2026?

report.interpretation: Total claim payments (agreed metric paid_amount: sum of payment amounts, counted by payment date) for each month of Q2 2026 (April to June), all products and states.
report.answer: Payments were $2,932,936 in April 2026, $2,986,014 in May and $3,268,589 in June. Q2 total is about $9.19M. June was about 9% above May.
report.answer_sql: WITH source AS (SELECT pay.* FROM claim_payments pay JOIN claims c USING (claim_id)) SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', payment_date) AS DATE) AS period, sum(amount) AS paid_amount FROM source WHERE payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND payment_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

data_quality_issues.issue: 159 duplicated payment rows from the off-schedule load reload-2026-03-14 (payments dated 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13).
data_quality_issues.impact: None on Q2: I found no off-schedule loads with payment dates in April to June. March totals would be overstated.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate payments from reload-2026-03-14
proposed_actions.reason: 159 rows repeat existing payments and inflate March 2026 paid totals.

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT pay.*, c.state, c.region, c.product, c.cause, c.adjuster_id, c.repair_shop_id
    FROM claim_payments pay
    JOIN claims c USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', payment_date) AS DATE) AS period, sum(amount) AS value
FROM source
WHERE payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND payment_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
